### 📓 Docs Drift Check
⚠️ **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/lint-root-preload.testkit.ts`, `packages/objectql/vitest.config.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/lint-root-preload.testkit.ts`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files. Nothing else in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **3** changed package(s)).

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/lint-root-preload.testkit.ts`, `packages/objectql/vitest.config.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/lint-root-preload.testkit.ts`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **42** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8c289725301becbb07dec2e3105b8bacff714abb` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:devx#2` · head `c1fdec3921694b9b92c81f58c700a9a48796a3db` · 2026-11-03T04:45Z

Checked against GitHub and the PR head, not against the report (os-dev-report 6595655176 on #29627).

- **Shape:** a draft to `main` with `Fixes #29627` once, `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. No assignees, no reviewers, `skip-changeset`. +240/−1 over 73 files: 66 test files gain a two-line module-top import, plus three `lint-root-preload.testkit.ts` modules, two `vitest.config.ts` alias lines, objectql's `package.json` and 3 lockfile lines.
- **Path surface:** `check-governed-merges --pr 29785` reads NOT governed (241 changed lines). No product code changes. The lazy `import('@objectstack/lint')` in metadata-protocol stays as designed.
- **Card rules, read in the diff and the report:**
  - **Measured, not grepped.** A run-time tracer over each package's whole suite found the first lint-root load inside a case in 66 files (runtime 9, metadata-protocol 39, objectql 18). Of the card's 149 grep candidates, 43 are kept and 106 dropped with 0 in-case loads. `packages-seed-apply-org-scope` is dropped (it never loads the root), and so is one file that loads it only in a `beforeAll` with a 120 s budget.
  - **The effect, p50 / max on the case that pays the first load (idle; 4-way contended):** metadata-protocol 714/838 → 25/65 ms (975/1241 → 29/88); objectql 796/1139 → 108/231 ms (1169/2282 → 139/347); runtime 237/542 → 119/384 ms (436/920 → 118/408). That is 924 samples with none failed. A second trace shows every one of the 66 files loads the root once, before any case runs.
  - ⛔ No timeout, retry, skip or assertion changed.
- **Accepted deviations:**
  1. **objectql's devDependency on `@objectstack/lint`** (`workspace:*`, plus 3 lockfile lines) is outside the claim's file list. It is forced, because `tsc` refuses an import of an undeclared package (TS2882). The seat checked for a cycle: lint depends on `formula`, `sdui-parser` and `spec`, none of which depends on objectql. Splitting objectql out would leave its 18 files cold. A shared setup file was measured and refused: about +39% suite wall time for objectql.
  2. **`skip-changeset`:** objectql ships only `dist/`, and a devDependency changes nothing a consumer installs. The seat lands on `Check Changeset` being green on this head.
  3. **Scope includes object publishes** (`build-probes.ts`), not only the view read the card names. 23 of the 66 files reach the same cold root only that way, at the same cost.
  4. The branch keeps a superseded setup-file commit and its reversal. The queue squash-merges, so `main` gets the net diff only.
- **Gate arm: not added.** The reason holds: the load is reached at run time through metadata-protocol's code and depends on test data, so a static source rule would conscript about 40 untouched packages.
- **Gates (the dev's readings):** `dispatch-gates --commands` 67 derived, 67 run, all exit 0 after a full build; `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED. Suites: metadata-protocol 22,292 tests, objectql 10,760 (+5 repo), runtime 8,540 (+1,211 repo), all exit 0. `check:test-source-alias`, type-check and eslint all exit 0. The seat lands once every check on this head is green.
- **Out of scope, not carded:** the dev's two notes. Packages outside these three that start the real protocol were not traced; aliasing lint to source in metadata-protocol would shorten its `check:test-source-alias` ledger row. Each is an optimisation with no red behind it. `Skills-docs: none — AGENTS.md's clocked-window rule already states the mechanism`.
- **Landing:** non-governed. Once every check on this head is green, the seat marks the PR ready and enables auto-merge.
